scope: BTCUSDT 2024-12-01 provider-clock engineering only; not full8 2026 evidence
asof_policy: provider receipt strictly before cutoff; equal-clock cross-stream boundary ambiguous
trade_batch_policy: retain all same-receipt trades; no within-batch ordering proof
duplicate_id_policy: same economic payload excluding receipt recorded once; conflicting payload rejected
last_batch_policy: discard last receipt group without a subsequent delimiter
missing_field_policy: raw empty string retained; normalized null, never zero
funding_policy: reported rate/time only; never synthesize settlement, debit or final rate
